children: According to ChainCatcher, trader Killa said Bitcoin may remain rangebound through year-end after its current downturn ends. He said markets typically trade within a range for weeks after sharp gains or declines, and estimated that markets spend about 75% of the time rangebound. Despite expectations for a V-shaped recovery, Killa said one is unlikely.

title: Trader Killa Sees Bitcoin Consolidating Through Year-End, Says V-Shaped Rebound Is Unlikely
